about: Every part in the kit, by folder name. Each folder holds part.json (its description) and the module it names. A preset is a part under another name with some of its defaults changed; a lesson uses it exactly like a part, and can still set anything the part has.

globe.title: Globe
globe.about: The map as a globe, the way stage 1 had it: projection globe, and no zooming by finger, so two quick taps on a pin step stay two taps. Every setting, call, event and state of the map works on it.
